# Work Humanizer

Edit AI-sounding text so it reads like a careful person wrote it, without changing

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Edit AI-sounding text so it reads like a careful person wrote it, without changing
what it says or commits to. Built for work writing where the wording matters: sales
and marketing copy, support replies, HR and legal letters, emails, docs, release
notes, posts, landing pages. Two modes. Rewrite: edit the text you are given.
Interview: when a draft is AI-composed and thin, ask the writer 3-5 sharp questions
and build the piece from their answers, in their words. Also writes from the
writer's own notes or a voice-memo transcript. Calibrated on measured differences
between human and AI writing.

Example request:

> Use work-humanizer to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill work-humanizer
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/work-humanizer/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/work-humanizer/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
